reviews.title: A much better alternative to your laptop's camera
reviews.comment:
This web camera is an excellent addition to my business practice. Previously, when on conference calls with clients, I used the video camera that came with my laptop. The placement of the laptop on my desk made the position of the camera less than optimal, and no matter what filters or lighting I chose, the video images were washed out and the sound was sort of tinny. The images from this camera are well-lit and clear, and superior to my laptop's camera in every way. The sound is also significantly better.
Set up was a no brainer, I just plugged it in and selected the camera, and it worked. It mounts (if you can call it that; it sits securely on top one of my external monitors) very easily, and the remote, which I didn't think I would use at all actually comes in pretty handy. It allows me to zoom in and out very easily and turn off the video and/or audio without having to reach for the mouse.
reviews.author: Theo from Boston

reviews.title: LOVE This Little Cam!
reviews.comment:
I do a lot of vids on YouTube, and many of them are lives.  This cam does a FANTASTIC job, and the picture quality comes out great!  That said, you definitely don't wanna count on the microphone that's installed on it; the sound quality won't come out good at all.  I use a high-quality external mic instead.  The only gripe I have with it?  Sometimes, when you move around, it tries to keep refocusing...and it might lose focus completely.  When that happens, I have to block it completely with my hand, and then it refocuses correctly.  Kind of a pain, but it doesn't happen very often.
For the price?  Yeah, it's really nice!

reviews.title: A solid webcam for the price with 4K zoom and pan capability
reviews.comment: After using several webcams, I wanted to find a unit that had built-in microphone capability, native zoom and image movement, and 4K capability.  This NexiGo webcam does all of the above relatively well. I have had some challenges with microphone audio quality but that could be due to my office setup, so I will continue to work on this and update.  That aside, the image quality is great as expected and the zoom/pan functionality is excellent.  The added remote makes image correction very easy to do without fumbling through an application. Image is bright and stable, and the remote allows brightness adjustment without having to goof around in Teams.  I have not observed excessive heat from this unit, and it seems to work seamlessly with Windows 11.  Overall, a good choice.
